tasks.title: prep-worktree: copy primary reference-impl/dist into spawned worktree
definition_of_done: `prepWorktree()` in `reference-impl/lib/prep-worktree.ts` calls `primeCopy(join(resolvedMain, 'reference-impl', 'dist'), join(worktreePath, 'reference-impl', 'dist'))` immediately after the existing `reference-impl/node_modules` copy step.

A regression test case is added to `reference-impl/tests/prep-worktree.test.ts` that asserts `<worktree>/reference-impl/dist/` exists and contains at least one `.mjs` file after `prepWorktree()` runs against a fixture primary repo.
All pre-existing tests in `reference-impl/tests/` continue to pass.
acceptance_criteria: Given a primary repo whose `reference-impl/dist/` contains `.mjs` files, after `prepWorktree()` completes the spawned worktree's `reference-impl/dist/` exists and contains those same `.mjs` files.
Running `prepWorktree()` a second time on the same worktree is idempotent: `primeCopy` wipes and re-copies without error.
A Reviewer or QA agent importing from `<worktree>/reference-impl/dist/lib/qa-report.js` (or any other dist entry) does not encounter a `Cannot find module` error after `prepWorktree()` completes.
No new build step (`npm run build`) is invoked inside the worktree's `reference-impl/` — the copy of primary's already-built dist is used directly.

tasks.title: SKILL.md: add git checkout main guard to scenario_brief and Next steps block to step-6 Report
definition_of_done: The scenario_brief template section of `reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md` contains an explicit paragraph beginning with "DO NOT run `git checkout main` from this worktree" that explains main is held by the primary repo, provides `git diff main..HEAD` as the safe comparison alternative, and provides `git show main:<path>` as the safe inspection alternative.

Step-6 (Report) of the same SKILL.md contains a `## Next steps (release publishing)` block listing the five post-merge release commands: `git tag -a reference-impl-v<VERSION> -m "reference-impl v<VERSION>"`, `git push origin main`, `git push origin reference-impl-v<VERSION>`, `(cd reference-impl && npm publish --access public)`, and `gh release create reference-impl-v<VERSION> --title "reference-impl v<VERSION>" --notes-from-tag`.

A regression test file (e.g., `reference-impl/tests/skills.test.ts`) is added or extended with cases that assert: (a) the string "DO NOT run `git checkout main`" appears in the SKILL.md scenario_brief section, and (b) the strings "## Next steps" and "git tag -a" appear in the SKILL.md step-6 Report section.
All pre-existing tests in `reference-impl/tests/` continue to pass.
acceptance_criteria: Searching `reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md` for the phrase "DO NOT run `git checkout main`" returns a match located within the scenario_brief template section.
Searching the same SKILL.md for `## Next steps` and `git tag -a` returns matches located within the step-6 Report section.

A new operator reading the scenario_brief receives an explicit prohibition on switching branches and is directed to `git diff main..HEAD` and `git show main:<path>` for safe main-comparison operations.
When a walker run reaches the Report step with all plan tasks in state `merged`, the printed output includes the five post-merge release commands listed in the `## Next steps` block.
The SKILL.md changes introduce no new external API surface (skill name, invocation arguments, and exit behavior are unchanged).

tasks.title: prepublishOnly sanity check: fail fast with actionable error when standard/ is not prepped
definition_of_done: `reference-impl/scripts/check-standard-prepped.mjs` exists and: (1) walks up from `process.cwd()` to locate the repo root by detecting `standard/package.json`; (2) calls `existsSync` on `<repoRoot>/standard/dist/` and `<repoRoot>/standard/node_modules/`; (3) if either is absent, writes to stderr "ERROR: standard/ is not prepped in this environment.\nRun:  cloverleaf-cli prep-worktree <primaryRoot> <worktreeRoot>\n  OR: (cd ../standard && npm ci && npm run build)" and exits with code 1; (4) if both are present, exits 0 with no output.
`reference-impl/package.json` `prepublishOnly` script is updated to `"node scripts/check-standard-prepped.mjs && npm test && npm run build"`, placing the sanity check before the vitest/tsc run.

A regression test is added to `reference-impl/tests/` that: (a) simulates a worktree environment where `standard/dist/` and/or `standard/node_modules/` are absent; (b) spawns `check-standard-prepped.mjs` as a subprocess; (c) asserts the process exits non-zero; (d) asserts stderr contains "standard/ is not prepped" and at least one remediation command.
All pre-existing tests in `reference-impl/tests/` continue to pass.
acceptance_criteria: Running `node scripts/check-standard-prepped.mjs` from a worktree where `standard/dist/` is absent exits with code 1 and prints to stderr a message containing "ERROR: standard/ is not prepped in this environment." and the two remediation options.
Running `node scripts/check-standard-prepped.mjs` from a correctly prepped environment (both `standard/dist/` and `standard/node_modules/` present) exits 0 and produces no output.

Invoking `npm publish` (or `npm publish --dry-run`) from an unprepped worktree terminates at the sanity-check step before vitest or tsc run, and the operator sees the actionable error message on stderr.

The script resolves the repo root correctly when invoked from any subdirectory within `reference-impl/` (e.g., `reference-impl/scripts/`, `reference-impl/tests/`) by walking up to find `standard/package.json`.

tasks.title: Release-prep custodian: bump version to 0.6.3 and finalize CHANGELOG for v0.6.3

Any tests in `reference-impl/tests/` that assert the package version string are updated to expect `0.6.3`.
All pre-existing tests in `reference-impl/tests/` continue to pass.
acceptance_criteria: `reference-impl/CHANGELOG.md` contains a section header matching `## 0.6.3` with date `2026-04-28`.

The `## 0.6.3` CHANGELOG section enumerates all four bug fixes from CLV-50: prep-worktree dist copy (fix #1), git checkout main guard (fix #2), prepublishOnly sanity check (fix #3), and post-walker Next steps reminder (fix #4).

No `## [Unreleased]` section remains in `reference-impl/CHANGELOG.md` after this task merges (the merge=union attribute allows non-custodian Documenters to have appended `## [Unreleased]` bullets during T1/T2/T3 — this task normalizes the final state).
This task runs only after CLV-52, CLV-53, and CLV-54 have all merged (enforced by DAG edges).
